title: What Full-Sensory Film Formats Is
definition: Full-Sensory Film Formats: films engaging all five senses.
description:
Full-Sensory Film Formats: films engaging all five senses. This is Future Entertainment & Play at its most ambitious — sensory rigs research, format logistics engineering and scent design operations converging on a single goal: making format hulls real.

title: Full-Sensory Film Formats Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Full-Sensory Film Formats: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Full-Sensory Film Formats — films engaging all five senses.

Phase 1 — Prove (sensory rigs): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (format logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (scent design): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (haptic scores): format hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and cinemas-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
